rec.name: Announcement Bar with Countdown Timer and Reviews Widget
rec.status: Built — delivered, mobile fix and timer text field added (Feb 2025)

what.text: A configurable announcement bar in the header group, above the main header. It is made of several blocks. Each block is an 'Announce something here' text message. There is also a Reviews.io widget block that shows the rating (e.g. '4.60 / 5 (10706) positive reviews'). A separate Countdown timer settings group has an on/off toggle, an end date and time, a text label shown before the timer, a link (e.g. to a product or collection), and background and text colors. On mobile the messages stack on separate lines on a green background.

why.text: A bar at the top of every page puts shipping info, offers and trust signals in front of every visitor. A countdown timer with a time-limited campaign (e.g. 'Noch Februar Aktion') creates urgency. Showing the review score and review count adds social proof from the first screen. The link takes visitors straight to the promoted offer.

how.text: Build a section in the header group with repeatable text blocks and a toggleable Reviews.io widget block. Add a countdown group with a toggle, a datetime text field (e.g. 'February 28, 2025 23:59:00'), a text field for the label shown before the timer, a link picker, and color pickers for background and text. Make the fields dynamic-source capable (the database icons suggest this). Stack the blocks on mobile so nothing overflows. Staff maintain the bar in the theme editor, and a Loom video explains how to maintain it.

items: Text before the timer (e.g. 'Noch Februar Aktion')

dependencies.text: Reviews.io app and widget for the rating block. Shopify theme with a header group that supports sections. Dynamic source fields (the database icons) are implied, but the ticket does not say which metafields are used. A Loom walkthrough exists but its content is not available.

items: Click-through rate on the bar link
Revenue of the promoted product or collection
Bounce rate and engagement with the first screen on mobile

images.caption: Theme editor: Announcement bar in the header group with several text blocks and a hidden Reviews.io Widget block. The green bar with stacked text is visible in the mobile preview.
Mobile view: stacked announcement text plus Reviews.io rating line ('4.60 / 5 (10706) positive Bewertungen') on a green background.
Countdown timer settings: toggle, end date/time, text before the timer, link, background and text color.
